units.sourceHTML: 10.1 Selecting the patch Input Format

units.text: ⟦0⟧ normally determines which ⟦1⟧ format the patch file uses by examining its contents. For patch files that contain particularly confusing leading text, you might need to use one of the following options to force ⟦2⟧ to interpret the patch file as a certain format of diff. The output formats listed here are the only ones that ⟦3⟧ can understand.
